newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-ARROWS SIGN GERMAN TEST DRIVER.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-ARROWS SIGN GERMAN TEST DRIVER.

text.p: European FIA Formula 3000 champion Joerg Mueller of Germany has joined world champion Damon Hill's TWR Arrows Formula One team as a test driver.

Arrows chief Tom Walkinshaw said after Monday's announcement: "We have been impressed not only by Joerg's lap times and the quality of his feedback but also by the speed with which he has gelled with other members of the team.
"He has slotted seamlessly into our test programme and is already doing much to ease the burden our heavy test schedule places on Damon and Pedro (Diniz, Hill's team mate)."
